title: The fine-structure constant from first principles: an exact zero-parameter Fold derivation
description:

The fine-structure constant from first principles: α⁻¹ = 503846395469/3676744786 = 137.035999177180855…

Maria Smith’s Smithian Fold Theory derives this exact ratio with zero free scientific parameters. Complete binary support fixes cover depths five and seven; the generated tower, boundary and cover are 128, 9 and 250. Promoting all three interchangeable directions produces the complete ladder 125, 175, 245, 343. Its exhaustion fixes the terminal order before measurement.

The paper develops the operational foundation, least Fold generator, independent spatial and boundary counts, general least-cover proof, typed assembly, all four exact order readings, complete 1,024-form grammar and uniqueness argument. Native Lean 4 verification retains zero axiom dependencies.

The original post-seal CODATA 2022 comparison retains the complete interval 137.035999177 ± 0.000000021. Exact integer cross-products prove that the sealed ratio lies inside both endpoints; its central displacement is approximately 0.008612 stated standard uncertainties. The complete 256-form empirical grammar, source identity and adverse controls are included.

Mathematics and reproducibility

All principal derivations and intermediate rational steps are in the paper. The accompanying archive supplies 220 native proof files including imports, original pinned V3 source, the registered CODATA snapshot and retained verification records. The formal alpha audit contains 156 declarations and the empirical-entry audit contains 136 declarations, with no axiom dependencies.
